annotation.evidence_span: Once a client receives a packet from the server which is not a Version Negotiation packet
annotation.interpretation_a: Any packet that isn't a Version Negotiation packet will trigger the ignoring of further Version Negotiation packets. This includes initial packets, data packets, etc.
annotation.interpretation_b: Only a successfully parsed and processed packet (i.e., one that doesn't cause an immediate error) that isn't a Version Negotiation packet will trigger the ignoring of further Version Negotiation packets. A malformed packet that is rejected would not count.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'a packet from the server' is not precise. Does it refer to any packet received from the server's IP address/port, or does it require successful parsing and processing of the packet? The difference is material because a client might receive a malformed packet that it discards, and it's unclear whether that should trigger the ignoring of further Version Negotiation packets.
annotation.missing_information: It is unclear whether a packet that fails to parse or is otherwise rejected counts as a packet 'from the server' for the purposes of this clause.
